description:
## Why
01167 unquotes a runtime-built 40-key map: `quote do: unquote(m)`. Elixir raises ArgumentError "tried to unquote invalid AST" (a map is not a quoted literal; Macro.escape/1 makes one). fz accepts the raw map, so 01167 keeps a twin.

## Decide with the owner
- Refuse (Elixir): unquoting a value that is not valid quoted AST raises ArgumentError with Elixir's message. 01167 spells `unquote(Macro.escape(m))` (lib/macro.fz has escape/1), converts to `# oracle: self`, and its twin is deleted. Not yet measured: how many other fixtures and lib macros unquote a raw value. The refusal's first full run counts them; each one is rewritten in this ticket.
- Keep it as an fz extension: 01167 keeps its twin and is listed by the fixtures.md ticket.

## Signal
Refuse: an oracle fixture shows the ArgumentError for a raw map, tuple of three and pid; one fewer twin; full gate green.
title: A macro that unquotes a value that is not quoted AST is refused, as in Elixir
